description: This class provides utility methods related to UI updates in a weather app, including icon selection based on weather conditions and translating day names to localized strings.

classes.name: UpdateUI
classes.description: Utility class with static methods for updating UI elements such as weather icons and day translations.

methods.name: getIconID
methods.description: Determines the appropriate weather icon string based on weather condition code, update time, sunrise, and sunset times.

methods.name: TranslateDay
methods.description: Translates English day names to localized strings using Android resources, based on the provided context.
